definitions.explanation: Water vapor or wetness in the air or in materials.

examples.english: There is a lot of humidity during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {湿気|しっけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまらない→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧。
examples.english: My hair won't stay in place because of the humidity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{湿気|しっけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こもり→こもる：07414_komoru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This room tends to trap moisture, so I use a dehumidifier. I especially run it every day in summer.

notes:
{湿気|しっけ} refers to moisture or dampness in the air or materials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {湿気|しっけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (high humidity)
- {湿気|しっけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こもる→こもる：07414_komoru⟧ (moisture builds up)
- {湿気|しっけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to remove moisture)
- {湿気|しっけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent moisture)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧ (humidity - as a measurement)
- ⟦{除湿|じょしつ}→除湿：09623_joshitsu⟧ (dehumidification)
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (dryness - opposite condition)

USAGE:
{湿気|しっけ} focuses on the tangible feeling of dampness, while ⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧ is used for numerical humidity measurements.
